app.name: ShellyLanMan
banner.noAuth: UI authentication is off: anyone who can reach this address can use ShellyLanMan. Keep it on a trusted network.
state.notYet: Not available yet in this version.
devices.table.title: Devices
devices.empty.title: No devices yet
devices.empty.text: No device found yet. Discovery keeps running; check the scan mode in Settings → Network.
page.checklist.text: The configuration checklist (eco mode, LED, logs, BLE, access point, roaming, Wi-Fi, range extender, scripts, automatic firmware update) will appear here.
page.charts.text: Live charts of power, voltage, current, temperature, humidity, RSSI and more will appear here.
page.deferred.text: Actions queued for offline devices will appear here and run when the device comes back online.
appearance.note: Appearance is stored in this browser only.
about.notice: ShellyLanMan is an independent project. It is not ShellyScanner and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Shelly Group. Shelly is a trademark of its owner.
about.basedOnText: ShellyLanMan is based on {name} by {author}: its functional and code reference.
firstrun.title: Welcome to ShellyLanMan
firstrun.text: ShellyLanMan discovers, monitors and manages Shelly devices on your local network. It is based on ShellyScanner by usnasoft.
firstrun.authNote: UI authentication is off by default. Only run ShellyLanMan on a network you trust, or put it behind a reverse proxy with authentication.
col.name: Name
login.title: Device login
login.useForAll: Use as default for all protected devices
login.stored: Credentials are stored encrypted in /data and never shown again.
action.reloadTip: Read the device again from its address
action.removeGhostConfirm: Remove this device from the archive?
action.removeGhostNotes: Its note will be deleted. Do you confirm?
scan.mdnsError: mDNS discovery could not start: {err}. Use IP scan, or run the container with host networking.
scan.noMdns: No device has answered mDNS after 30 seconds. In Docker bridge networking mDNS does not work: use network_mode: host, or switch to IP scan in Settings → Network.
scan.offline: Offline mode: showing archived devices only (Settings → Network).
scan.ticsHelp: How many status refreshes run before the configuration is refreshed too; 1 means every time. Full-rate refresh runs only while a browser has ShellyLanMan open; otherwise devices are checked once a minute.
cred.title: Restricted login
cred.text: Default credentials for protected devices (Gen2+ devices always use the user admin). Per-device credentials can be set with Login on a device.
archive.text: The archive remembers devices, their last address and your notes, so devices that are off or asleep still appear (as archived).
archive.autoReload: Auto reload (mDNS modes: about 45 s after a scan starts, archived devices are looked for at their last address)
archive.clearConfirm: Notes will be permanently deleted. Do you confirm?
filter.label: Filter devices
action.webUITip: Open the device's own web interface
action.webConfirm: {n} web pages will open. Do you confirm?
logs.paused: ShellyLanMan refresh suspended for this device
logs.hint: Shows the device's debug log when its websocket log is enabled (Checklist → Logs).
prefs.note: These display options are stored in this browser.
cmd.cbConfirm: Confirm you want to toggle the circuit status?
lights.title: Lights editor
action.checklistTip: Configuration checklist of the selected devices
action.settingsTip: Wi-Fi, login, MQTT and other settings of the selected devices
cfg.title: Devices settings
cfg.wifiConfirm: Warning. Wrong parameters may cause devices to disconnect from the network. Are you sure you want to apply the changes?
cfg.mqtt.reboot: Note: devices must be rebooted to make new settings effective.
cfg.err.staticIPRequired: IP is required for static IP
cfg.err.staticMaskGWRequired: Netmask and Gateway are required for static IP
cfg.err.ssidRequired: Both SSID and Password are required.
cfg.err.userRequired: Both User and Password are required
cfg.err.cloudRequired: Please select the required cloud status
cfg.err.resetRequired: Please select the required "input reset" status
chk.title: Devices configuration checklist
chk.tip.ble: Number of connected bluetooth devices (Gen2+) / number of gateways (BLU)
chk.tip.extender: Number of devices connected to the range extender (if enabled)
deferred.intro: Actions for devices that were off line run when the device is back. Waiting:
deferred.empty.title: No deferred tasks
deferred.empty.text: Settings applied to an off-line device are queued here.
slow.title: MQTT settings
slow.label: Pause between devices (tenths of a second)
slow.help: Extra wait after each device when MQTT settings are applied to several devices (ShellyScanner's -slow option).
backupKeep.title: Backups
backupKeep.label: Backups kept per device
backupKeep.help: Older backups are deleted after a new one (0 = keep all). Backups are stored in /data/backups.
restore.title: Restore - {host}
restore.src.file: A backup file from this computer (.sbk)
restore.src.none: No backups of this device yet.
restore.confirm: Restore the configuration of {host} now? Its current settings will be overwritten.
restore.confirmQueued: {host} is archived: the restore will be queued and run when the device is back. Continue?
restore.multiConfirm: Restore {n} devices from their newest backups? Passwords are not restored; scripts are overwritten and enabled like in the backup.
restore.queued: The device is currently offline or protected - Task queued
restore.successReboot:
Configuration successfully restored.
Reboot the device to apply all settings
restore.msg.PRE_QUESTION_RESTORE_HOST:
You are going to restore a device with data originating from a different device
(hostname: {value}).
Confirm restore?
restore.msg.ERR_RESTORE_MODEL: The configuration you are trying to restore comes from a different device model
restore.msg.ERR_RESTORE_CONF:
Device configuration and backup configuration are not mutually compatible.
Please manually modify the device configuration and try again.
restore.msg.ERR_RESTORE_MODE_COVER:
Device configuration and backup configuration are not compatible (Switch/Cover).
Please manually modify the device profile and try again
restore.msg.ERR_RESTORE_MODE_THERM:
Device configuration and backup configuration are not compatible (Switch/Thermostat).
Please manually modify the device profile and try again
restore.msg.ERR_RESTORE_MODE_TRIPHASE:
Device configuration and backup configuration are not compatible (monophase/threephase).
Please manually modify the device profile and try again
restore.msg.ERR_RESTORE_PROFILE:
Device current profile ({current}) and backup profile ({backup}) are not compatible.
Please manually modify the device profile and try again
restore.msg.ERR_RESTORE_POWER_BASE: Device power base and backup power base are not compatible
restore.msg.WARN_RESTORE_ADDON_CANT_INST: Sensors installation list will not be restored since one or more sensors are already configured on the destination device
restore.msg.WARN_RESTORE_ADDON_INSTALL: Please reboot the device at the end of the process and execute Restore again to restore the full sensors configuration
restore.msg.WARN_RESTORE_ADDON_ENABLE: Please reboot the device at the end of the process and execute Restore again to restore the sensors
restore.msg.WARN_RESTORE_XMOD_IO: Inputs and/or Outputs will be only partially restored since their current number is not equal to the stored number
restore.msg.WARN_RESTORE_BTHOME:
BTHome devices can't be restored by ShellyLanMan.
Please add the devices manually to obtain a full restore.
Actions/Webhooks linked to BTHome devices will not be restored and will display an error message
restore.msg.WARN_RESTORE_LORA_ENABLE: Please reboot the device at the end of the process and execute Restore again to restore LoRa settings
restore.msg.RESTORE_LOGIN:
The stored configuration contains data for restricted login.
Please enter the password and press "OK", or press "Skip" to skip the restricted login restore
restore.msg.RESTORE_WI_FI1:
The stored configuration contains data for primary Wi-Fi.
Please enter the password and press "OK", or press "Skip" to skip the Wi-Fi restore
restore.msg.RESTORE_WI_FI2:
The stored configuration contains data for Wi-Fi 2.
Please enter the password and press "OK", or press "Skip" to skip the Wi-Fi 2 restore
restore.msg.RESTORE_WI_FI_AP:
The stored configuration contains data for a protected AP.
Please enter the password and press "OK", or press "Skip" to skip the AP restore
restore.msg.RESTORE_MQTT:
The stored configuration contains MQTT server credentials.
Please enter the password and press "OK", or press "Skip" to skip the MQTT restore
restore.msg.QUESTION_RESTORE_SCRIPTS_OVE:
There are scripts on the device with colliding names ({value}).
Press "Rename" to rename the incoming scripts with a '_restored' suffix.
Press "Skip" to prevent scripts restore.
Press "Overwrite" to overwrite the existing scripts
restore.msg.QUESTION_RESTORE_SCRIPTS_ENA:
Some backed up scripts were enabled ({value}).
Do you want to also enable these scripts after restore?
They will be running after the reboot
restore.err.ERR_RESTORE_MODE_COVER: Device configuration and backup are not compatible (Switch/Cover)
restore.err.ERR_RESTORE_POWER_BASE: Device power base and backup power base are not compatible
fw.title: FW Update
fw.intro: The devices check for new firmware themselves. Tick a version and press Update; progress is shown while the devices download and restart.
lfw.colTip: Latest stable firmware in Shelly's index, compared by ShellyLanMan (for devices that cannot check themselves)
lfw.title: Local firmware download
lfw.qrAlt: QR code of the download link
lfw.howto: Scan the code with your phone while it is on this network: the file is downloaded from ShellyLanMan, which fetched and checked it. Then connect the phone to the device's own access point, open its update page and upload the file. Compare the version above with the one the device shows.
lfw.warn.localhost: This link uses localhost: a phone cannot open it. Set the address for phones in Settings → Network.
lfw.warn.badBase: The address for phones is not valid. Check it in Settings → Network.
phone.title: Local firmware download
phone.label: Address of ShellyLanMan for phones
phone.help: Used in the QR codes of the local firmware download, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:3082. Empty: the address this browser uses.
action.notesTip: Notes and keyword of the device
notes.title: Notes - {device}
